source: Local macOS ARM64 run; not a GitHub Actions result
regressions: Fresh photo attempted in both channels before older photos
Broken old report does not block current photo
Recovery drains newest photo first and then all remaining photos
Channel failure cannot block the other channel; accepted receipts are preserved
Archive yields to scheduled capture and continues in bounded passes
Delayed Telegram caption and SMTP subject/body preserve capture time and are labelled as queued
Validated network recovery triggers retry without repeated capability-event flooding
Real scheduled camera capture attempts delivery before corrupt old report (API25 and API35)
Real alarm during blocked archive request captures after current request ends (API25 and API35)
limitations: Real Telegram token and SMTP account not used
Reboot evidence for 0.2.0 is separate; 0.2.1 reboot checks run in CI
